AI coding agents working on morphir-scala:

**AI agents MUST NOT be listed as authors or co-authors of git commits.**
Do NOT use `Co-authored-by:` trailers for AI agents
Do NOT add AI agents to commit author fields
The human developer who reviews and commits the code is the sole author
This is a FINOS-wide policy that applies to all projects under the FINOS umbrella.

Scala 3.7.4; Mill 1.1.x; ZIO; ScalaJS; experimental Scala Native. Main areas: `build.mill`, `mill-build/src/`, `morphir/`, `.config/mise/`, `project/`.

Use mise:
mise run setup
mise run lint
mise run fmt
mise run test:jvm
mise run test:js
mise run ci:local

Or Mill:
./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.compile
./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.test
./mill mill.scalalib.scalafmt.ScalafmtModule/reformatAll 'morphir.__.sources'

Cross-platform modules use `src/`, `jvm/src/`, `js/src/`, `src-3/`, `jvm/src-3.7/`. scalafmt 3.10.4, Scala 3 dialect, 120 columns. Run `mise run fmt` before committing. Use `given`/`using` instead of `implicit`; prefer `enum`, `derives`, `extension`; import with `*`; use `mvn""`, not `ivy""`; prefer ZIO libraries. Tests use ZIO Test, `test/src/`, and `ZIOSpecDefault`. Run tests with `mise run test:jvm` or `./mill morphir[3.7.4].__.jvm.test`.

For modules: follow `build.mill` patterns, create matching source directories, update `platformSpecificModuleDeps` and parent dependencies. Check Scala 3.7.4 compatibility, source placement, and Mill 1.x deprecations. Run `mise run lint`.

Use `./mill --no-server -j 1` for deterministic builds. Check `./mill resolve __`; inspect with `./mill show <target>.sources`.

CI includes lint, JVM/JS tests, and publish. Work is NOT complete until all CI checks pass on the Pull Request. Use `gh pr checks <pr-number> --watch --interval 30`; investigate failures immediately. Do not mark task as done. Check comments with `gh pr view <pr-number> --json comments,reviews`. Resolve all comments and verify fixes locally. Only when CI is green and comments are zero/resolved is the feature complete.
